QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Choosing Survival
QuestInfo.1: You cannot let Victoria Island fall to the schemes of the Black Mage. You must defeat the fairies and stop the forest from being poisoned.\n\n
QuestInfo.0: Ephenia, the queen of the fairies, has joined forces with the Black Mage. You must stop her.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated 100 #o5250005# monsters and 150 #o5250006# monsters. That should limit the spread of poison... for now.

0.0: We must stop the poison from spreading through the forest. I humbly ask for your aid. You will help us, will you not?

yes.0: Go to the Fairy Forest and #b#eeliminate 100 #o5250005# monsters and 150 #o5250006# monsters#n#k. We cannot allow them to spread their poison further.

no.0: Please...this is the time for action, not reflection.

yes.0: Thank you. It was an unfortunate necessity, but the poison's spread should be limited. However, there is still an important task to be done.

mob.0: It pains me to say it, but those fairies need to be dealt with. We cannot allow their poison to spread.
